def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    cost = 120000
    salvage_value = 20000
    useful_life = 5
    year = 3

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    depreciable_amount = cost - salvage_value
    sum_of_years = useful_life * (useful_life + 1) // 2
    remaining_years = useful_life - year + 1
    depreciation_expense = depreciable_amount * remaining_years / sum_of_years

    # Return the answer rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(depreciation_expense)
